caption: The drawing depicts a decorative gas bracket mounted on a wall, presented in a technical illustration style. The bracket features intricate ornamental scrollwork with a prominent curved arm extending outward and upward from a detailed mounting plate. There is an ornamental finial at the top of the bracket and a central decorative element resembling a human face integrated into the design. The bracket is shown affixed to a flat vertical surface rendered with straight parallel lines to represent architectural paneling or wall sections. The image is monochromatic, consisting of fine black ink lines on an off-white or beige paper background. Dimensions are indicated with straight arrows and numbers around the bracket: 25 ½ inches horizontally at the top, 12 ½ inches vertically on the right, and 15 inches vertically further to the right. Below the drawing, a rectangular label reads "GAS BRACKET" in uppercase letters.
title: Cast Iron Lighting Brackets
